raw:
```sql
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN c."Continent" = 'Asia' THEN ch.population ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
  / SUM(ch.population) AS asia_population_ratio
FROM main."country_history" ch
JOIN main."country" c ON ch.code = c."Code"
WHERE ch.effective_month = '2026-03'
```
